Depth: Depth: occupancy-map path distance (geodesic_m) to a segmented instance in one pano. Args: pano_id, object, optional instance_id. Example: {"action":"Depth","pano_id":4,"object":"<goal>"}
Look: Look: one discrete pitch/yaw step. Prefer down to see floor blockers. Args: look in {up, down, left, right}. Example: {"action":"Look","look":"down"}
Recall: Recall: fetch stored images of an old scan node (does not move). Args: node_id, pano_id, optional query. Example: {"action":"Recall","node_id":2,"pano_id":4,"query":"compare with earlier object"}
MakePlan: MakePlan: lock a subgoal. Args: pano_id, mode in {semantic, frontier}, plan (short English). semantic requires object_query; frontier must omit object_query. Example: {"action":"MakePlan","pano_id":4,"mode":"semantic","object_query":"sofa","plan":"Approach the sofa."} or {"action":"MakePlan","pano_id":2,"mode":"frontier","plan":"Cross the door into the corridor."}
TraceBack: TraceBack: walk the body to an older node. Args: node_id. Example: {"action":"TraceBack","node_id":2}
Verify: Verify: terminal when state is Find. Args: pano_id only (a direction with goal_find). Harness approaches <goal> then checks two views. Example: {"action":"Verify","pano_id":4}
Locate: Locate: approach the locked navigation goal in one pano. Args: pano_id only. Harness stops when geodesic is close enough. Example: {"action":"Locate","pano_id":4}
